boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer pipe casing surface exchanging heat with the warm environment through convection and surface radiation

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner tube wall held at the refrigerant temperature u_C (constant-temperature condition imposed as a penalty Robin condition)

constants.name: R
constants.description: outer radius of the pipe cross-section

objective.name: J
objective.description: Weighted material cost plus a weighted integral of the outer-casing temperature; minimising J keeps the casing cold, i.e. it maximises the heat absorbed from the environment through the outer boundary Gamma_o.

state_equation.description: Non-linear state problem for u in P2(D); the u^4 radiation term makes it non-linear.
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} \operatorname{pen} u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} \varepsilon \sigma u^{4} \delta u \,ds_x
state_equation.weak_form_rhs: \int_{\Gamma_i} \operatorname{pen} u_{C} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h u_{amb} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} \varepsilon \sigma u_{amb}^{4} \delta u \,ds_x

newton_linearisation.description: The state is updated as u <- u - \hat u; the radiation term is linearised as \partial_u [\varepsilon \sigma (u^{4} - u_{amb}^{4})] \hat u = 4 \varepsilon \sigma u^{3} \hat u.

adjoint_equation.description: Adjoint state \tilde u; the adjoint operator is the linearisation of the state operator at u (self-adjoint for the symmetric conduction-convection-radiation operator). The adjoint load comes from \partial_u J(\delta u) = \int_{\Gamma_o} q_b \delta u \,ds_x.
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k \chi (\nabla \delta u \cdot \nabla \tilde u) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_i} \operatorname{pen} \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} h \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_o} 4 \varepsilon \sigma u^{3} \delta u \tilde u \,ds_x

boundaries.name: \Gamma_o
boundaries.description: outer pipe casing surface exchanging heat with the warm environment through convection and surface radiation

boundaries.name: \Gamma_i
boundaries.description: inner tube wall held at the refrigerant temperature u_C (constant-temperature condition imposed as a penalty Robin condition)

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: Dirichlet label reconciled from LaTeX boundary name \Gamma_i to mesh label 2; all other field attributes are from the extracted spec.

constants.name: R
constants.description: outer radius of the pipe cross-section

constants.name: k
constants.description: thermal conductivity of the solid conductor used in the state weak form (equal to k_0)
constants.rationale: The state weak form uses symbol k; set it equal to the extracted solid conductivity k_0.

expressions.name: q_flux
expressions.rationale: Derived heat flux for thermal post-processing.

expressions.name: q_rad
expressions.rationale: Surface radiation heat flux at the outer casing.

expressions.name: q_conv
expressions.rationale: Convective heat flux at the outer casing.

optimization_config.level_set_initial: \phi_0(\mathbf{x}) = \min\left( r - r_0,\; R - r,\; -\min_{k=1}^{N} \left( r_{\mathrm{hole}} - \sqrt{(x_0 - r_m\cos\theta_k)^2 + (x_1 - r_m\sin\theta_k)^2} \right) \right),\; r = \sqrt{x_0^2+x_1^2},\; N=8,\; r_m=(r_0+R)/2,\; r_{\mathrm{hole}}=0.05
optimization_config.rationale: hmin/hmax, diffusion, v0 and iterations are designed from the 0.5 m domain scale; level_set_initial is a signed-distance seed for an annular solid with a ring of eight holes at the mid-radius; boundary_labels and fixed_labels preserve the extracted design roles of the non-10 boundaries; ell/Afac is left for pipeline calibration.
